newsitem.title: UK: Safeway opens mid-size format store.
newsitem.headline: Safeway opens mid-size format store.

text.p: British supermarket group Safeway Plc launched a new format mid-size store on Tuesday to complement its existing superstores.
"This new format will complement our existing programme of superstore development and consolidate our presence in...market towns," marketing director Roger Partington said in a statement.
The 18,000 square feet store is in Kirkham, Lancashire, north west England and will have a similar product range to superstores of 30,000 square feet and more.
It will also have a coffee bar, meat counter and delicatessen, parking for 180 cars and 12 checkouts.
Safeway plans to open four further stores of this size this year.

Supermarkets have increasingly found problems in gaining planning permission for large, out-of-town superstores and market leader Tesco and J. Sainsbury have both experimented with smaller, in-town store formats.
